newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX BRENT STEADY, EXPECTED TO RISE ON TECHNICALS.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX BRENT STEADY, EXPECTED TO RISE ON TECHNICALS.

text.p: September Brent futures remained steady in late trading on Tuesday.
September Brent on SIMEX was traded at $18.58 per barrel, unchanged from London's close after it had risen by 10 cents.

Despite the sidewards trading, brokers were more on the bullish side, expecting prices to be propped up by technicals and a drawdown in American Petroleum Institute's (API) crude stocks as a result of strong refinery demand.
API oil stocks data will be released later on Tuesday.
"A rise in crude stocks on the API will come as a surprise," said a broker in Singapore.
"The market is technically oversold, so prices should have some support" he added.
September Brent opened firmer on London's IPE and was last traded at $18.62.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded at $19.72, up three cents from New York's $19.69.
